transformations.description: Uses the complete BND operator code as the stable identity suffix and creates a singleton StopPlace for each new directional StopNode.
Stores four official directional lists independently with closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or closing edge is inferred.
Retains the official Wednesday/Sunday market-service rule as provenance without changing route graph topology.
Captures the official Benidorm Centro–Els Tolls–Foietes–Adolfo Suarez route in both directions as a current source snapshot under the project-owner legacy naming policy.
Reuses 21 complete StopNode and StopPlace objects exactly from accepted Benidorm component scenarios; creates 26 new composite identities.
Uses 21 exact accepted positions, one public-map anchor and 25 reviewed development street/corridor positions.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and computes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from final serialized bytes.

warnings: The project-owner naming policy uses legacy, while route evidence is a current 2026 capture.
Line 006 is a limited Wednesday/Sunday market service; its operating-day rule is provenance and does not create additional route patterns.
The new coordinates are development-stage. Replace them only with exact authoritative coordinates while preserving accepted composite IDs.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
